nodes.description: External interface function init(uint numTokens, address target) declared in ReservoirLike; defines the callable surface reachable through the proxy delegatecall.
External interface function drip() declared in ReservoirLike; callable surface reachable through the proxy delegatecall.
Payable fallback function of Proxy; forwards all calldata via delegatecall to a hardcoded implementation address 0x9a2E280aAeB4dE82AAD34Df9c114f67A1699744c.
Assembly delegatecall(gas, 0x9a2E280..., 0x0, calldatasize, 0x0, 0) executing arbitrary calldata in the context of the proxy storage; the target address is hardcoded and immutable.
Caller of the payable fallback; any externally owned account or contract can trigger the delegatecall with arbitrary calldata.
uint numTokens parameter of ReservoirLike.init controlling the number of tokens initialized.
address target parameter of ReservoirLike.init used as an initialization target; attacker-influenced when routed through the proxy.

edges.reason: The fallback body unconditionally transfers control to the assembly delegatecall using the raw calldata.
Any msg.sender can invoke the fallback and thereby drive the delegatecall with arbitrary calldata, giving unrestricted access to the delegated implementation logic.
The target address parameter delivered via calldata reaches the delegatecall's execution context, allowing attacker-controlled arguments to influence the delegated call.
